summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests chemoradiation followed by chemotherapy plus dostarlimab for stage IIIC, node-positive endometrial cancer. Participants receive chemotherapy for 6 cycles, and dostarlimab is given by IV starting at cycle 3 for up to 2 years, as long as the disease does not get worse or toxicity is not acceptable. The study measures safety and tolerability, as stated in the title, and no other outcome measure is stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa quimiorradiación seguida de quimioterapia más dostarlimab para cáncer endometrial en estadio IIIC con ganglios positivos. Los participantes reciben quimioterapia durante 6 ciclos, y el dostarlimab se administra por vía intravenosa desde el ciclo 3 por hasta 2 años, mientras la enfermedad no empeore y la toxicidad sea aceptable. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, según indica el título, y no se establece ninguna otra medida de resultado.
who_for: Surgically staged stage IIIC, pathologically confirmed endometrial cancer, eligible for adjuvant chemoradiation followed by chemotherapy.
Enrolled within 8 weeks of surgery and started treatment within 10 weeks of surgery.
Adequate blood counts, kidney, liver, and clotting function within 14 days before enrollment.
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-CTLA-4 antibody therapy.
Severe allergic reaction to monoclonal antibodies or dostarlimab.
Active or recurring autoimmune disease, or history of interstitial lung disease or non-radiation pneumonitis.
Daily steroids or other immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days before enrollment, or immunodeficiency.
Known HIV, clinically significant liver disease, or uncontrolled intercurrent illness.
